title: Hearing concerns in a child
presentation: A child brought with parental concern about hearing. Age to be added.

groups.name: Conductive
items: Otitis media with effusion (glue ear), the commonest

tables.title: Developmental hearing milestones (verify)
rows: Startles to loud noise; newborn hearing screen

management: Ask parents what they have noticed: ICE, speech, school, behaviour.
Examine ears and look for syndromic features.
Refer to audiology if concern persists, even with a normal screen.
Glue ear: watchful waiting, then ENT if persistent with impact (follow NICE).
Safety-netting: return with ear pain, discharge, or fever, or if speech is worsening.
pearls: Parental concern is a strong predictor: always act on it.
A normal newborn screen does not exclude later loss.
lookUp: NICE glue ear guidance (NG233) and referral thresholds

selfTest.q: Commonest cause of conductive loss in children?
Child passed newborn screening but parents worry. Action?
selfTest.a: Refer to audiology; later loss can occur.

sources: NICE NG233 Otitis media with effusion (verify)
